explanation_full: Based on the feature distributions, Ethanol and Acetate have the highest mean values, with Ethanol having a mean of 0.4736 and Acetate having a mean of 0.4465. Regarding variability, Ethanol and Butyrate exhibit the highest standard deviations, with Ethanol having a standard deviation of 0.2528 and Butyrate having a standard deviation of 0.2474. Other features like Propionate (mean: 0.3675, std: 0.2158) and VSS (mean: 0.3581, std: 0.1538) show lower means and standard deviations.
